name: What should I do if I suspect a main sewer line blockage right now?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I suspect a main sewer line blockage right now?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you suspect an immediate main sewer line blockage, the first step is to stop using all water-fixtures in your home to prevent further backups and potential flooding. Avoid flushing toilets, running faucets, or using dishwashers and washing machines. Next, locate your main water shut-off valve and turn off your water supply if you see any signs of a backup, such as water rising in your toilet or coming out of a drain. Then, contact a professional plumbing service like CG Plumbing Solutions immediately for emergency assessment and clearing. Prompt action can minimize damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you suspect a main sewer line blockage, stop using all water, turn off your main water supply if needed, and immediately contact a professional plumbing service for emergency assistance.
